## Problem and change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link the related issue, if any.

## Validation

List the checks run and their results. Explain any check not run and why.
For native changes, include the manual desktop check.

## Review checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and follows CONTRIBUTING.md.
- [ ] Relevant tests and documentation are updated, or no update is needed.
- [ ] UI text uses i18n and shared controls, or no UI text changed.
- [ ] Contracts, compatibility coverage and ADRs are updated if a boundary changed.
- [ ] No credentials or private conversation content are included.
